entries.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
entries.summary: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

entries.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
entries.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

entries.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

entries.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
entries.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

entries.title: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
entries.summary: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

entries.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
entries.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

entries.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
entries.summary: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

entries.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
entries.summary: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

entries.title: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
entries.summary: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

entries.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
entries.summary: See how Amp pushes the frontier of what agents can do with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.
